Hey, I’m Gaspard :wave:

I help tech startups turn their SaaS’ unique value into clear differentiation—so they stop competing on features and price, and start becoming buyers’ first pick.

In 2023, I specialized in what seemed like the most valuable marketing skill: Messaging.

I thought demand would come easily. After all, helping companies communicate their value should be the easiest thing to sell, right?

I was wrong.

My offer was new, different, and high-impact, but prospects didn’t immediately see why they needed it. They didn’t have a category for it in their minds, so they defaulted to comparing me to copywriters, UX designers, and generic marketing freelancers.

Selling took forever. To close deals, I either had to lower my price or add more services—which only made things worse. Instead of reinforcing my expertise, it diluted it.

I had blended in.

That’s when I realized: if buyers don’t instantly see how you’re different, they assume you’re just like everything else.

The best solution doesn’t win, the one that is easiest to recognize as the best fit does.

This problem isn’t unique to me. I see it with SaaS startups every day—products that are truly innovative but get stuck in comparison battles, forced to justify their value over and over.

And when they try to fix it themselves, they either overcomplicate their messaging—making it harder for buyers to grasp the value—or simplify too much, losing what makes them different and getting compared to generic alternatives.

That’s why I created my advisory program—to help SaaS startup founders own the space where they’re the best choice.

I admire entrepreneurs who carve their own path and build an innovative solution. And it’s incredibly frustrating to see so many fail—not because their product isn’t good enough, but because they don’t present it in a way for buyers to instantly see its unique value.

Let’s change that.

Together, we’ll make your SaaS stand out, attract the right customers, so you can build the business (and life) you set out to create.

DM me &quot;Difference&quot; and I&#39;ll take it from there. · Expérience : PurpleOceans · Formation : IIM Digital School · Lieu : Paris · 500 relations ou plus sur LinkedIn. Consultez le profil de Gaspard Pastural sur LinkedIn, une communauté professionnelle d’un milliard de membres.
